framing: native vertical 9:16, picture fills the tall frame
style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, satire, bright sunlit interior
character: iridescent blue-green peahen, glossy crest, red lipstick on her beak, gold necklace, heavy jewelled earrings, red painted nails on her feet, fills two thirds of the frame
props: white marble catwalk into the lens; a tall mirror on wheels rolling ahead of her; a giant open wallet on wheels beside her, mouth gaping; two magpie stylists on her back with pliers and a spool; price tags on the stripped quills
prop_continuity: fan full until 4.3; thinning from 4.3; bare frame with tags from 5.1; jewellery and lipstick throughout
motion_rule: she drives at the lens every window and never holds a pose; new shot size every window, camera always moving
environment: sunlit arcade, glass roof, blurred shoppers

audio.delivery: smug preening female voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: VNESH-niy, bez-u-PRE-chen, ko-SHEL-ke, TOL-ko, PER-ya
audio.pacing: steady natural tempo, never hurried; nothing said after 7.5
audio.lip_sync: beak opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: nails clacking on marble, pliers snipping, feathers rustling

timeline.a: she bursts through a paper hoop at the lens, chest first, crest flying
timeline.c: big close on her chest, whip to her face

timeline.a: she strides the catwalk at the lens, nails clacking, earrings swinging, both magpies riding her back
timeline.c: big close on her beak, push out

timeline.a: the rolling mirror swings in beside her and she preens at her reflection without breaking stride
timeline.c: low tracking past the mirror, her and the reflection

timeline.a: the first magpie hauls a quill from her fan and rams it at the lens into the wallet mouth
timeline.c: big close low on the quill and wallet, whip

timeline.a: she rears over the rolling wallet, neck into frame, the second magpie ratcheting the spool on her flank
timeline.c: tight frontal from below, push in

timeline.a: both magpies rip out a fistful of quills and her fan collapses to a bare frame, tags swinging
timeline.c: mid three quarter on the thinning fan, whip

timeline.a: she catches the bare frame in the rolling mirror, blinks at it and drives on at the lens
timeline.c: low tracking on the mirror glass, whip to her face

timeline.a: both magpies shove the last quills into the gaping wallet mouth at the lens
timeline.c: big close low on the wallet mouth, whip to her face

timeline.a: she drives at the lens and throws the bare quill frame wide open behind her, tags whipping
timeline.c: tight low frontal, hard push in

timeline.a: the wallet gapes at the lens and a storm of feathers erupts out over her face
timeline.c: big close low on the wallet mouth and her face

timeline.a: she charges through the feather storm at the lens, both magpies flung off her back
timeline.c: low frontal racing back ahead of her

timeline.a: she rams the bare frame open into the lens, wallet swinging in the middle, and throws her head past the camera
timeline.c: big close low frontal on her face and the bare fan

must_appear: red nails on her feet, gold necklace, jewelled earrings and red lipstick on her beak; her reflection in the rolling mirror; the tail fan stripped to a bare quill frame with tags; the wallet hanging in the middle of it; a storm of feathers erupting from the wallet mouth; her face to the lens in the final window
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, any lettering in frame, a square picture padded into a tall frame, letterbox, static camera, a static wide with her small in frame, she stands still while speaking, she holds a pose in the last window, banknotes, coins, a full lush tail fan after 5.1, the magpies standing still, English speech, any word after 7.5
